_meta.purpose: Request payload sent after the user explicitly selects a tenant in the context picker. Drives identity µservice's SetSessionContext.

webauthn_credential_id.description: Same credential id from the TwoTenantsResponse.

selected_tenant_id.description: Tenant the user picked. MUST be one of the tenants returned in TwoTenantsResponse.tenants[].tenant_id.

selected_audience_type.description: Audience type the user is operating as. Per ADR-0244 §audience_type extension.

second_factor.description: PIV/CAC or other 2FA per FedRAMP Mod IA-2(1) for FedRAMP-Mod cells.

assertion.description: Opaque second-factor proof. Validation per identity µservice's stepup-orchestrator (IP-010).
